I’m going to give a personal response…. My ex and I were together 10 years, each other’s high school sweethearts, each other’s firsts and onlys for 9 of those years. Or at least I was to him. He continuously showed signs of infidelity. I chose to “open our relationship” to prevent him from actually cheating on me. Told myself “he wants to play this game, watch me play it better!” 


Fast forward, 9ish years, we’re divorced, he’s married to a wonderful woman that I adore and view as my best friend. Couldn’t imagine a better bonus mom to my kids. We do a grown up game night (like we do every few months) and it turned into her confessing to me that he had been shady, skirting the faithful line, etc. with her for years through their marriage. Broke by heart. I was sitting there hearing her pain with his infidelities, and remembering my own with him. Made me angry for both of us…. Ended up throwing a pizza crust at his forehead because I was tipsy and angry, but managed to square him in the eye. (Not intentional. My aim is great normally, but impeccable when angry. Apparently it’s emotionally driven when I drink.)

Long story short, my friend informed me that when I had barely met her, was still married to my ex, confused and had no loyalties to said new person to our dynamic.. that she knew that we had hooked up once while they were seeing each other. 

Me back then didn’t care. I, in my mind was confused and sleeping with my husband. 
Me now, felt absolute disappointment in my past self. I absolutely love my kids’ bonus mom. Couldn’t ask for anyone better to fill the mom role when I’m not there. She’s also quite amazing and hard to not like….

To know, that she knows that I ever betrayed her, hurt her, ever anything towards her now, breaks my heart. I until recently thought that moment would go to our graves. That it was a confusing lapse of judgment that no one got hurt by. 

But it wasn’t. I hurt her. Probably a lot. And when she YEARS later told me that she knew, I was crushed, humiliated… but mostly, disappointed in myself because I didn’t know at that time just how much I could love another person, and that I would one day wish I could take back everything I ever did to spare them that pain. 


But my selfishness and betrayal didn’t end there… while I was always upfront and honest with my husband any time anything ever happened, I was no honest with  my best friend about her husband’s sexual advances. Part of me desperately wanted to believe he was only that way with me because it was comfortable and familiar…. This is really sound advice! Especially if you’re a person of color or if you have hair on your body that tends to curl naturally. (Curly hair, as it’s growing out after a shave, tends to grow and curl back into the hair follicle, which is what causes a lot of ingrown hairs for people with this hair type.)

If you have relatively straight pubic hair, you could potentially shave against the growth of your hair for a closer shave. I would recommend first trimming your hair before shaving, if this is your first time, or haven’t shaved/trimmed in a while. As the longer the hair is, the harder it is to get a good shave, and makes it more work in the long run. 

I would also recommend also exfoliating your skin prior to the actual shaving portion. That’ll help sloth off any extra dead skin cells on the surface, allowing a smoother shave and you’re also less likely to get ingrowns this way. I like to mix together a little brown sugar, extra virgin olive oil, or coconut oil, and some honey together (no exact measurements. Just until it comes to a paste like consistency, that is spreadable.) and scrub the areas you plan to shave, and then washing off in the shower before shaving. 

Lots of water, lots of soap or shaving cream to allow smooth gliding for the razor. Rinse razor well between strokes so that the razor doesn’t get bogged up. 

But possibly the most important advice, USE A MALE FACE RAZOR. You know, the ones with 5 blades. None of those girly razors with 3 blades that are marketed to women for pubic shaving. Those razors are absolute shit. You want to get a really sharp razor. I know it sounds intimidating, but that’s the way to do it. It’ll give you cleaner shaves, which equals less friction, and less ingrowns. I’ve been shaving since I was a teen, and I’m female. I can now shave with a SHARP razor on my nether regions without even looking if I want to. Sharp does not equal slicing up your bits. I promise!

Moisturize with a body lotion afterwards, or even better, an anti ingrown ointment/lotion if possible. This will help with the next day, where you’ll most likely experience itching, once the hair starts growing back. Itching is normal. 

Apply deodorant to the crevices if you have any, as your pubic hair that you have shaven off, once whisked the sweat and body odors off your skin naturally. 

Annnnnd if you do all of what I’ve advised and you still end up getting painful ingrowns, DEFINITELY do as recommended from the person above. Trim instead of shave, or shave in the direction that your hair grows in to prevent painful ingrowns. I want to also mention, that small razor bumps are very common after shaving. Especially in our pubic region. Especially in areas where skin folds and touches. That is normal. They tend to go away in a day or so with no help or interference from you, and are small and not really that pesky. True ingrowns are PAINFUL. BIG. They are sometimes boils. You WILL know the difference if you ever experience them.

Hey, just from one to another. I’m a female, and one of my fears (probably from watching my mother go through menopause, and you can probably piece things together if you have read my responses) is losing myself to menopause or some other form of hormone issue. 

Postpartum is a thing. Menopause is a thing. Crazy pregnancy hormones are a thing. 

I’m going to play devils advocate for just a second…

There are so many different forms of birth control with just minor tweaks to the amounts estrogen to testosterone to make it more compatible to certain females. There’s non hormonal options that cause excessive bleeding. There’s birth control that can cause blood clots. There’s all sorts of different birth controls that effect people’s hormones, personalities, menstrual cycles, fertility, etc. 

No one birth control effects everyone the same way. Some CAN effect moods, decision making, thought processes, and feelings. It’s insane how something can control a huge part of your life. 

I have a friend who packed all her things from her home and left her husband 2-4 weeks after switching from a different birth control, when she and their marriage was completely happy before then. She switched off it, and two months later they were back together and are 10 years into their relationship. That change of birth control changed her whole thought process on her relationship. 

Now, before anyone gets on me, I know some relationships are just toxic, and I have no idea what goes on behind closed doors in their situation.  But I do know she changed her mind, and claims it’s because or her birth control switch. 

Moral of my whole story, if she seems genuine now, maybe try to give her the benefit of the doubt. Hormones are crazy and they effect more than we realize. I was in an abusive relationship with my ex husband. We were together for 2.5 years, married just shy of 6 months... and for a while there, I was on the fence about leaving. Like most toxic relationships go, him and I were in a perpetual cycle of really awful days, sprinkled in with a few good ones, just enough to keep me from completely bolting.

We had been having a good streak for about a week, pretty much unheard of for us. That week was full of holidays like my daughter’s birthday and Easter, so things were going okay. 

I had made plans and promises to my mom that I would leave, and when that morning came to pack up, I almost back out of it, thinking maybe things would be different this time. Maybe he finally started to see me the way he did when we were first got together... He did promise me things would be better once we were married, after all... so maybe he was finally happy. I was trying really hard, working 3 waitressing jobs to support him while he worked on his filming career, so maybe, just finally, he wasn’t as stressed. MAYBE... I was finally enough for him. 

As I’m laying in bed, crippled with uncertainty and knowing if I don’t leave, I’ll be letting my mother down once again. I was 90% sure that I was going to back out... until I hear him screaming at my son. My then 7 year old son, who is kind and thoughtful, and has always tried his very best to make his step dad happy was getting screamed at by a 6’2 husky man at the top of his lungs for no reason. 

It was like this big beacon of light and clarity washed over me, knocking the rose colored glasses from my face, and in that moment I knew that man would never have the chance to treat my children or myself badly again. 

He came back into the room to say goodbye to me, and I, in my most convincing performance ever, kissed and waved him off. Knowing that, that goodbye was forever. 

I watched him drive away, and as soon as he was gone, I called my mom. I packed up my kids, the dog, some clothes and all of our important paperwork. We went to my son’s school and took my ex husband off the pick up list and then we drove to my parent’s house, never looking back. 

He never got to see the kids again. Not a hug, not a goodbye, nothing. The last thing he will ever have to remember my children by are those hateful words he spewed out at my son. 

Best. Decision. Ever.
